text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock A and D just because they were above my average cost; a gain on an individual position is not by itself a reason to sell.","Selling winners early can leave my portfolio concentrated in weaker holdings; I should judge positions by their role and prospects, not by reluctance to realize a loss.","These few periods do not reveal a reliable price pattern, so I should avoid treating recent gains or declines as forecasts and make decisions with a consistent, diversified plan."]}
